composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Runs first. When the 'Idempotency-Key' header repeats a key already seen, short-circuit with a
# 200 replay of the originally created owner (before the duplicate check below would 409); otherwise
# publish the key for RecordIdempotency and continue building.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic householdId first (SHA-256 over lastName + postcode), so the
# household duplicate check below can compare it. Owners at the same last name and postcode
# are the same household.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject a second owner in an existing household (same householdId) with 409, unless the
# request set 'sharesHousehold' to declare it a household member.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyOwnerLimit

ensureDailyOwnerLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# A declared household member is not flagged. Any other owner reaching here is not a household
# duplicate (EnsureUniqueIdentity already rejected those), so possibleDuplicate stays false.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Owner is now persisted (id assigned); remember it against the Idempotency-Key (if any) so a repeat
# replays this owner. No-op when the request carried no key.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they take precedence. On the response it is the
            composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it
            is normalized and appended (after a single space) to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to
            15 digits after the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned when supplied. Omitting it is accepted.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            not supplied on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same last name and postcode (a shared
            household), declaring it a household member. When false or omitted, such a
            duplicate is rejected with 409. Not stored on the owner.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                last name when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. So '+61412345678' is
                shown as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
                first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household: the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Assigned to every owner, so owners at the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the
                householdId (or empty when absent), joined with '|'. A create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Determined at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on last name and
                postcode at creation, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) containing the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. So a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 falls in the fiscal
                year ending 2027 and yields 'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY
                is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) containing the
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or
                more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners have already been created for this
                owner's registrationDate (the same per-day accumulation the daily create
                limit enforces), signalling an unusually high volume of signups that day;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted: DELETE retains the record and
                flags it deleted rather than removing the row, and the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. A newly
                created owner is not deleted (false).
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they take precedence. On the response it is the
            composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it
            is normalized and appended (after a single space) to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to
            15 digits after the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned when supplied. Omitting it is accepted.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            not supplied on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same last name and postcode (a shared
            household), declaring it a household member. When false or omitted, such a
            duplicate is rejected with 409. Not stored on the owner.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                last name when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. So '+61412345678' is
                shown as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
                first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household: the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Assigned to every owner, so owners at the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when
                absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined with '|'. A create is
                rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                (non-deleted) owner's.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Determined at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on last name and
                postcode at creation, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) containing the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. So a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 falls in the fiscal
                year ending 2027 and yields 'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY
                is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) containing the
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or
                more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners have already been created for this
                owner's registrationDate (the same per-day accumulation the daily create
                limit enforces), signalling an unusually high volume of signups that day;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted: DELETE retains the record and
                flags it deleted rather than removing the row, and the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. A newly
                created owner is not deleted (false).
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
